description: This file contains a set of API utility functions for interacting with a backend server, including GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, as well as specific functions for managing work items and comments within a project management system.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds headers object with Authorization token if available.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or null.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, parsing and returning JSON data.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item given project_id and item id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage or provided argument.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, setting creator info from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL for an API path.
